name: Turn Start
description: Increments the mission year, publishes EvTurnStarted, and refreshes unit moves

name: Resource Collection
description: Collects resources from all bases for each faction

name: Unit Support
description: Charges home-unit mineral support against this turn's mineral bank; disbands units the base cannot support. Must run after ResourceCollection has banked minerals and before BaseProduction

name: Base Production
description: Allocates leftover minerals to the queued build or converts them through a stockpile, then completes funded items. Must run after UnitSupport and before BaseGrowth so Hab Complex / Dome can raise max size before growth, and before IncomeCollection / ResearchAccumulation so stockpile econ and labs are spent this turn. Colony-pod abandon uses WouldGrowThisTurn plus CommitPendingGrowth before Instantaneous pop costs

name: Base Growth
description: Applies each base's nutrient production: PopulationManager subtracts citizen intake, then grow or starve, half tanks when full at the population limit, then deposit and cap. Must run after ResourceCollection has banked nutrients and after BaseProduction so a Hab facility completed this turn unlocks growth the same turn

name: Income Collection
description: Collects econ stockpile from all bases and transfers income to the faction energy pool

name: Upkeep
description: Retires expired deploy records and charges facility energy upkeep against the faction treasury; must run after IncomeCollection has banked this turn's econ

name: Population
description: Processes population changes and drone/talent balance

name: World Events
description: Handles random world events like mindworms and fungus

name: Victory Condition Checks
description: Checks if any faction has achieved victory

name: Player Actions
description: Executes pending unit orders at the end of the turn

name: Post Actions Production
description: Completes funded production queues after PlayerActions without banking leftover minerals or clearing same-turn abandon deferrals. Finishes items hurried (or otherwise funded) during the player window

name: Mood
description: Commits pending drone riots and golden ages after the player has had a chance to respond

name: Turn End
description: Finalizes the end of the turn
